data.what_it_does: Provides command line tools to manage, build, and run Serverpod applications. It handles code generation and orchestration tasks for Serverpod projects.
use_when: You are developing a backend or full-stack app using Serverpod.
You need to run code generation for your Serverpod models and endpoints.
avoid_when: You are not using the Serverpod framework for your backend.
You only need client-side network libraries.
strengths: Simplifies server and database management during development
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Serverpod ecosystem and not useful on its own
data.setup_notes: Installed via the Dart SDK or activated globally using pub.
